tag: 法規里程碑 · 競品動態
body: Biohaven troriluzole（Vyglxia®）用於SCA之NDA重新送件，2026/10/22獲FDA受理審查。FDA認定本次送件為針對2025/11 CRL之完整回覆，核予PDUFA目標日2027年第一季，並計劃召開PCNS藥物諮詢委員會會議徵詢外部意見（確切日期未公布）。公司稱送件納入新增之正面支持性分析，具體數據未揭露。
note: → 最接近核准之口服競品重啟審查節奏，詳見results.json／exclusivity.json新增筆目。

en.body: Biohaven's troriluzole (Vyglxia®) NDA resubmission for SCA was accepted for FDA review on 2026/10/22. The FDA considers it a complete response to the 2025/11 CRL, assigning a PDUFA goal date of Q1 2027, and plans to convene a PCNS Advisory Committee meeting for external input (date not yet announced). The company states the resubmission includes new supportive positive analyses, with no specific data disclosed.
en.note: → The oral rival closest to approval has restarted its review clock — see the new entries in results.json / exclusivity.json.

tag: 併購 · 競品公司動態
body: IntraBio 同意由日本塩野義製藥（Shionogi）以 20 億美元現金全股收購。塩野義董事會於 2026/10/05 核准該交易並同日簽約，交易預計 2026 年第四季完成，尚待反壟斷等監管許可與 IntraBio 股東同意。IntraBio 主力資產為 levacetylleucine（Aqneursa®），已於 Niemann-Pick C 型上市，2026/09/19 另獲核准用於 A-T（毛細血管擴張性共濟失調）；IntraBio 另有 Pompe 氏症、Fragile X 症候群等臨床管線。公司稱 2025 年度淨銷售額約 6,790 萬美元。此次為塩野義繼 2026/04 以 25 億美元收購 Radicava（ALS 用藥）後、在罕病領域的又一樁收購。
note: → 本公司於日本申請之 SCA6 適應症與 IntraBio 的 IB1001-304（CACNA1A 相關疾病，含 SCA6）樞紐試驗正面重疊（詳見 competitors.json intrabio 條目）。交易公告未提及 CACNA1A／SCA6 適應症後續規劃，本站不臆測收購後該資產開發節奏是否改變；僅記錄為公司層級背景動態。⚠️ 收購仍待完成，交易條件（尤其反壟斷與股東同意）存在不確定性。

en.body: IntraBio has agreed to be acquired outright by Japan's Shionogi & Co. for USD 2.0 billion in cash. Shionogi's board approved the deal and the parties signed on 2026/10/05; closing is expected in Q4 2026, pending antitrust and other regulatory clearances and IntraBio shareholder consent. IntraBio's lead asset is levacetylleucine (Aqneursa®), already marketed for Niemann-Pick disease type C and approved on 2026/09/19 for ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T); its clinical pipeline also includes Pompe disease and Fragile X syndrome programmes. The company reported roughly USD 67.9 million in net sales for 2025. This follows Shionogi's USD 2.5 billion acquisition of the ALS drug Radicava in 2026/04, part of a broader rare-disease push.
en.note: → Our own SCA6 filing in Japan overlaps directly with IntraBio's IB1001-304 pivotal trial in CACNA1A-related disorders, which includes SCA6 (see the intrabio entry in competitors.json). The deal announcement says nothing about plans for the CACNA1A/SCA6 indication, and this site does not speculate on whether development pace would change post-acquisition; it is recorded only as corporate-level background. ⚠️ The deal has not yet closed, and terms — particularly antitrust clearance and shareholder consent — remain subject to uncertainty.

tag: 競品受挫 · 補收既有結果
body: 主動發現廣掃比對既有競品資料庫時，查得兩項此前未收錄於平台之競品受挫事實：① PTC Therapeutics樞紐試驗MOVE-FA（NCT04577352，vatiquinone／PTC743）主要指標於mITT／ITT分析集均未達統計顯著（p=0.144／0.0984），與2025/08之FDA CRL結論一致，公司另稱完成者子集與延伸數據正面但非預設主要分析；② Astellas Gene Therapies之FRDA心肌病變基因療法ASP2016 Ph1b試驗（NCT06483802）已於2025/11以企業決策撤回、實收0人。
note: → 兩者皆非近7天內新事件，為本次廣掃比對既有trials.json時發現之資料缺漏補收，詳見trials.json與results.json新增筆目。

en.body: A broad discovery scan comparing against the existing competitor database surfaced two competitor setbacks not previously recorded on the platform: (1) PTC Therapeutics' pivotal MOVE-FA trial (NCT04577352, vatiquinone/PTC743) did not reach statistical significance on its primary endpoint in either the mITT or ITT analysis set (p=0.144 / 0.0984), consistent with the 2025/08 FDA CRL; the company separately cites a positive completers subset and extension data, neither of which was the pre-specified primary analysis. (2) Astellas Gene Therapies' FA-cardiomyopathy gene therapy ASP2016 Ph1b trial (NCT06483802) was withdrawn by corporate decision in 2025/11, with 0 patients ever enrolled.
en.note: → Neither event occurred within the past 7 days; both were backfilled after today's broad scan found gaps against the existing trials.json. See the new entries in trials.json and results.json for detail.

tag: SCA3 試驗讀出 · 追蹤名單外新路線
body: SCA3 出現一個主要指標達標的口服小分子隨機對照試驗：中南大學湘雅醫院團隊於 Movement Disorders（2026/09/15 線上）發表 DL-3-n-丁苯酞（NBP）治療 SCA3 的 12 個月隨機安慰劑對照試驗。mITT 116 人，SARA 12 個月變化組間差 −0.86（95% CI −1.56 至 −0.16；P=0.02）、SCAFI 差 0.16（P=0.03），雙主要指標皆有利於 NBP；兩組無嚴重不良事件，藥物相關不良事件 NBP 組數字上較多（21.4% vs 10.0%，P=0.09）。
note: → 與本公司同一核心適應症（SCA3）、同一主要量表（SARA）。⚠️ 效果量小（一年差距未達 1 SARA 分）、單一國家研究者發起、分析族群為 mITT；摘要未載盲法、站點數與試驗登錄號，ClinicalTrials.gov 以藥名查無登錄，本站不代為補寫。作者自稱為「初步」證據，距任何監管申請仍遠。

en.tag: SCA3 trial readout · new route outside the tracked list
en.body: A randomised controlled trial of an oral small molecule has met its primary endpoints in SCA3: a Xiangya Hospital (Central South University) group published in Movement Disorders (online 2026/09/15) a 12-month randomised placebo-controlled trial of DL-3-n-butylphthalide (NBP) in SCA3. In an mITT population of 116, the between-group difference in 12-month SARA change was −0.86 (95% CI −1.56 to −0.16; P=0.02) and in SCAFI 0.16 (P=0.03), both primary endpoints favouring NBP; there were no serious adverse events in either group, and drug-related adverse events were numerically more frequent on NBP (21.4% vs 10.0%, P=0.09).
en.note: → Same core indication (SCA3) and same primary scale (SARA) as Steminent. ⚠️ The effect size is small (under one SARA point over a year), and the study is single-country, investigator-initiated and analysed in an mITT population; the abstract does not state the blinding, number of sites or registration number, a drug-name search of ClinicalTrials.gov finds no registration, and nothing is filled in here. The authors call the evidence 'preliminary', and any regulatory filing remains distant.

tag: 競品公司動態 · 非 SCA 資產
body: Biohaven 另一條主力管線遭 FDA 部分臨床暫停：公司 2026/09/09 向美國 SEC 提交 8-K 揭露，FDA 於 2026/09/04 發函，對 Kv7 鉀離子通道促效劑 BHV-7000（opakalim）的局部癲癇試驗 BHV7000-302、-303 及開放標籤延伸 -201 施以部分臨床暫停，範圍僅限「新病人收案」；已隨機分派的逾 600 名受試者繼續給藥。原因是囓齒類試驗觀察到的某一代謝物資訊不足、尚無法評估對人體的風險，FDA 要求補充非臨床資料。公司稱 BHV7000-303 已完成收案、topline 仍維持 2026 下半年。BioSpace 報導公司股價於 09/10 盤前下跌逾 13%。
note: → 本則與 troriluzole／SCA 無直接關係——8-K 全文未提及 troriluzole 或 SCA，本站不推論此事對 troriluzole 在 2025/11/04 CRL 之後的重新送件時程或資源配置有何影響。收錄理由是 Biohaven 為本站主要追蹤競品，公司層級的研發挫折屬背景訊號（BioSpace 同篇報導回顧：troriluzole 遭拒後公司研發預算削減 60%、BHV-7000 憂鬱症二期 2025/12 失敗）。⚠️ 「股價跌逾 13%」「研發預算削減 60%」為媒體報導數字，非 8-K 原文；BHV-7000 於 2026/08 下旬與 SK Biopharmaceuticals 簽授權，各報導金額口徑不一，本站不引用。

en.body: Another lead Biohaven programme has been placed on partial clinical hold by the FDA: in an 8-K filed with the US SEC on 2026/09/09, the company disclosed that the FDA issued a letter on 2026/09/04 placing its focal epilepsy trials of the Kv7 potassium channel opener BHV-7000 (opakalim) — BHV7000-302 and -303 and the open-label extension -201 — on a partial clinical hold limited to new patient enrolment; more than 600 patients already randomised continue dosing. The reason is that information on a specific metabolite observed in rodent studies is insufficient to assess its risk to humans, and additional nonclinical data were requested. The company says BHV7000-303 is fully enrolled and topline data remain on track for the second half of 2026. BioSpace reported the shares fell more than 13% in premarket trading on 09/10.
en.note: → This has no direct bearing on troriluzole or SCA — the 8-K does not mention troriluzole or SCA, and this site draws no inference about any effect on the timing or resourcing of a troriluzole resubmission after the CRL of 2025/11/04. It is recorded because Biohaven is a principal tracked competitor and company-level R&D setbacks are background signal (the same BioSpace report recalls a 60% R&D budget cut after the troriluzole rejection and the failure of BHV-7000's Phase 2 in depression in 2025/12). ⚠️ The 13% share fall and 60% budget cut are media-reported figures, not from the 8-K; BHV-7000 was licensed to SK Biopharmaceuticals in late August 2026, and because reported deal values differ between outlets, none is cited here.

tag: 監管里程碑 · 已核准
body: 共濟失調圈層出現第一個以 SARA 為註冊主要指標獲 FDA 核准的案例：IntraBio 的 levacetylleucine（AQNEURSA®）於 2026/09/19（PDUFA 行動日當天）獲 FDA 核准，用於治療毛細血管擴張性共濟失調（A-T，體重≥15公斤之成人與兒童）的共濟失調症狀——為全球第一個 A-T 核准療法。核准依據為樞紐三期 IB1001-303（NCT06673056），公司與 FDA 均稱其主要指標與全部關鍵次要指標達統計顯著。同成分已以 Aqneursa 於 Niemann-Pick C 上市。
note: → 對本公司有兩層意義，方向相反。（一）有利：這是共濟失調領域第一個以 SARA 為註冊主要指標走完 FDA 審查並獲准的案例，等於替「SARA 可作為註冊終點」建立監管先例，對本公司以 SARA 為主要指標的開發路徑是外部背書。（二）警訊：同一分子的 IB1001-304 明列 SCA6、與本公司日本申請適應症正面重疊；此次 A-T 率先核准後，該分子在共濟失調醫師社群的熟悉度、安全性資料庫與給付路徑都已領先本公司一步。⚠️ FDA 與公司公告均未附具體數值、p 值或效果量（IB1001-303 於 2026/05 首度揭露時亦同）。

en.body: The ataxia ring now has its first FDA approval of a filing whose registrational primary endpoint was SARA: IntraBio's levacetylleucine (AQNEURSA®) was approved by the FDA on 2026/09/19 (its PDUFA action date) to treat ataxia symptoms in ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T, adults and children ≥15 kg) — the first approved therapy for A-T anywhere. The approval rests on the pivotal Phase 3 IB1001-303 (NCT06673056), which the company and the FDA both describe as meeting its primary endpoint and all key secondary endpoints with statistical significance. The same molecule is already marketed as Aqneursa in Niemann-Pick disease type C.
en.note: → Two implications for us, pointing in opposite directions. (1) In our favour: this is the first filing in the ataxia field to complete FDA review and be approved with SARA as its registrational primary endpoint, establishing the precedent that SARA can serve as a registrational endpoint — external validation of our own SARA-based development path. (2) A warning: the same molecule's IB1001-304 explicitly lists SCA6, overlapping the indication in our Japan filing directly, and having secured the A-T approval first, it now leads us in physician familiarity, safety database and reimbursement pathway across the ataxia community. ⚠️ Neither the FDA announcement nor the company has released specific figures, p-values or effect sizes (also true of IB1001-303's initial disclosure in 2026/05).
